statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is indicated for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
This service directly supports the documented diagnosis of R00.2 (unspecified palpitations) and R42 (palpitation) by capturing intermittent arrhythmic activity associated with the patient's symptoms.
The diagnosis codes are R00.2 and R42.
The denial reason code is CO-50.
The service was not deemed medically necessary under current coverage guidelines.
